newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 2.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivory Coast's oil refinery SIR to be privatised before the end of 1997, Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan and Mines and Energy Minister Lamine Fadika tell staff - Striking workers at Franco-Ivorian shipyard CARENA risk the sack as strike illegal, senior government official says LA VOIE - Lack of transparency over mooted privatisation of Ivorian cotton company CIDT
